title: Not a checklist: an "is everything okay?" glance dashboard, which needs a new status component
prompt: Build a glance dashboard that answers "is everything okay?" at a look. It shows three rows: the baby monitor ("Sleeping since 13:10"), a package ("En route, arriving today") and the home server ("Up, 12 days"). Each row has a label, a one-line detail and a state of ok, warn or bad that is visible at a glance (color plus text, not color alone). The values arrive in a <ui-store name="home"> (for example {"baby": {"state": "ok", "detail": "Sleeping since 13:10"}, ...}) and the rows must update live when the store changes, with no inline script. This is a monitor, not a to-do list: nothing is checked off. If the library's components cannot do this honestly, do NOT write inline script, onclick handlers or a to-do list dressed up as a dashboard. Instead write a request for a new component (request.md): what is missing, why no existing component fits, and the proposed tag with its attributes, events, slots and CSS custom properties, following CLAUDE.md.
